name: Rhapsody of the Fear
source:
Vampire Kyle lives a quiet forest with a were-cat girl, but one day she suddenly disappears. Strange rumors reach Kyle, so he seeks support in the only person he trusts - his half-brother Larc. But how will Kyle find Larc who is travelling around the world all the time?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
吸血鬼凯尔和一名猫人女孩住在一片安静的森林里，但有一天她突然消失了。凯尔听到了奇怪的谣言，因此他向他唯一信任的人——他同父异母的兄弟拉克寻求支持。但凯尔要如何找到一直在世界各地旅行的拉克呢？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
